CouncilMode.description:
How the council ran (SPEC-0012 R6).

- `one_mind`: Every role in a single context.
- `independent`: One executor per role, each reading only the brief in the first round.

CouncilQuestion.description: An unresolved conflict of the council, for the maintainer to decide.

answer.description: The answer of the maintainer, one of `options`; absent until decided.

id.description: Identifier within the report, `Q<k>`, cited as `COUNCIL-<seq> Q<k>`.

options.description: The possible answers; at least two.

items.description: A prose text of at least one character, in the language of the document.

recommendation.description: The answer the council recommends, one of `options`.

CouncilStatus.description:
Status of a council report (SPEC-0001 R5); `draft` is its initial status.

- `draft`: Written by the moderator, not approved.
- `approved`: Approved by a person on its gate issue, every question answered; the roadmap may be generated from it.
- `superseded`: Replaced by the council reports in `superseded_by`; terminal.

Decision.description: A decision of a council report.

id.description: Identifier within the report, `D<k>`, cited as `COUNCIL-<seq> D<k>`.

Dissent.description: The position of a role that disagrees with a decision of the report.

decision.description: The decision of this report it disagrees with, `D<k>`.

RejectedAlternative.description: An option the council considered and rejected.

description: A council report (SPEC-0001, Council report): the moderator report on a brief (ADR 0016, SPEC-0012 R4). Stored as `plan/council/COUNCIL-<seq>.yaml` in this normalised form.

dissent.description: Positions that disagree with a decision; `[]` means none.

id.description: Stable identifier, in the canonical form of the type; assigned by the engine and never reused (SPEC-0001 R2, R14).

language.description: Language of the prose, a BCP 47 tag; when absent, the language of the project.

questions.description: Unresolved conflicts for the maintainer; `[]` means none.

rejected_alternatives.description: Options considered and rejected; `[]` means none.

risks.description: Risks and their mitigation; `[]` means none.

roles.description: The roles that gave an opinion; at least one.

items.description: The name of a role of the council, as the project configures it, for example `critic`; an identifier rather than prose, of at least one character.

schema_version.description: Version of the schema of the type the document was written against (SPEC-0001 R16).

status.description: Current status (SPEC-0001 R5), not the issue-cycle state of SPEC-0002.

superseded_by.description: Identifiers of the artifacts of the same type that replace this one, at least one; required when `status` is `superseded`.

items.description: Identifier of a council report: `COUNCIL-` and four digits, or five or more without a leading zero, for example `COUNCIL-0001`.

title.description: Outcome or name, in sentence case without a final full stop; 1 to 120 characters (Unicode code points).

title: CouncilReport
